title: 散会走在最前
summary: The hearing breaks up and the family spills out of the hall; 陆蔓 strides at the front of the deep veranda with her back to camera, her heels landing hard on the blue bricks.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: the hall doors open onto the veranda after the hearing and the family spills out; 陆蔓 (S8) walks at the FRONT of the deep corridor with her back to camera, an umber-red wool shawl over her dark-green qipao, hips square and chin high; 苏小满 (S1) follows half a step at her left-rear, facing 陆蔓's back; 小罗 (S7) is the NEAREST of the three to camera, his face turning between the two women; the veranda's west side is a run of timber balustrades with the courtyard's pomegranate tree beyond, and the blue brick floor and the corridor curb hold the bottom third of frame.
[Shot 1] Wide along the corridor's depth axis, camera at the near end: the hall doors sit behind the group, the veranda runs away from the lens toward the moon gate at the far end, and 陆蔓 (S8) leads with her back to camera, each heel beat landing hard on the blue bricks.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, medium with the bottom third held by blue brick and corridor curb: 陆蔓's (S8) long shadow is thrown across the seams; the balustrade and the pomegranate tree line the left of frame, the hall doors the right.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, wider along the depth: the three of them in a single file — 陆蔓 (S8) furthest down the veranda, 苏小满 (S1) next, 小罗 (S7) nearest to camera — and never abreast.
soundscape: Afternoon wind moving the courtyard leaves, 陆蔓's (S8) heels striking blue brick in a heavy rhythm, the swish of the wool shawl at her shoulders, and the low voices of the family dispersing behind her.

title: 给你的纸条，你一眼都没用
summary: Without slowing her stride the old lady tips her head half an inch over her left shoulder and drops a low needle-sharp line about the note.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) walks at the front of the deep veranda with her back to camera; 苏小满 (S1) follows half a step at her left-rear facing her back; 小罗 (S7) trails a further half step behind 苏小满 (S1), nearest to camera, his face travelling between the two women;  the blue brick floor and the corridor curb hold the bottom third of frame.
[Shot 1] Close, over-shoulder: 陆蔓's (S8) half profile and the back of her head hold the near of frame with her back to the lens; at her left-rear and lower in frame 苏小满 (S1) keeps her eyes on the brick ahead of her own shoes.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, 陆蔓 (S8) does not stop walking, only tips her head half an inch toward her left-rear, jaw tight, and speaks low enough that only the person behind can hear: [Chinese] 给你的纸条，你一眼都没用。
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, tight on the taut line of 陆蔓's (S8) cheekbone as she turns her face forward again; she deliberately does not slow her step for the girl behind her.
soundscape: 陆蔓's (S8) heels on the blue brick, the drag of the shawl across her shoulders, courtyard wind in the leaves, and two low voices kept behind her.

title: 假的，说不出口
summary: Following half a step behind, the young woman answers levelly in four words, her eyes on the brick in front of her shoes, without lifting her head.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) follows half a step at 陆蔓's (S8) left-rear, facing the far end of the veranda; 陆蔓 (S8) walks ahead with her back to camera; 小罗 (S7) trails a further half step behind 苏小满 (S1), nearest to camera, his face travelling between the two women;  the blue brick floor holds the bottom third of frame.
[Shot 1] Close over-shoulder, 苏小满 (S1) in the near of frame and a little lower: she answers without quickening; on the first two words her eyes stay on the blue brick ahead of her shoes, and on the last she still does not lift her head.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.200, 苏小满 (S1) answers levelly in Mandarin, with neither defence nor retort, stating it once as if she will not say it twice: [Chinese] 假的，说不出口。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, medium down the axis: the older woman's back still moving away, the younger one trailing with her chin down, and the veranda running long between the lens and the moon gate.
soundscape: Two sets of footsteps on the blue brick, the drag of the umber shawl ahead, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, and one low voice carried behind another.

title: 你！
summary: The old lady whips round on the spot, one word caught shaking in her throat, then swallows the rest and clenches her fingers on the shawl.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) walks half a step behind 陆蔓 (S8) with her head down; 陆蔓 (S8) is ahead with her back to camera and still moving away; 小罗 (S7) trails a further half step behind 苏小满 (S1), nearest to camera, his face travelling between the two women.
[Shot 1] Close on 陆蔓 (S8): she whips her head round, her foot finally stopping and her shoulder turning with it; she opens her mouth and the word comes out tight and shaking: [Chinese] 你！
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, tight on her face: she stares half a second, her lips move, and she swallows the rest of the sentence back — there are always ears along the Lu veranda.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.600, low and close on her right hand: her fingers clamp tight on the edge of the umber shawl; small in frame behind her, 苏小满 (S1) has stopped and looks back at her.
soundscape: The abrupt stop of two pairs of heels on blue brick, the creak of the shawl under her grip, courtyard wind through the balustrade, and a single word cut short in a tight throat.

title: 律师那边透话
summary: The steward steps half a pace into the gap between the two women, bows his head low and reports that the lawyer's side has let something slip.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) has stopped and half turned, her right hand still clamped on the shawl; 苏小满 (S1) has stopped half a step behind her; 小罗 (S7) stands at 苏小满's left-rear; the veranda runs away to the moon gate.
[Shot 1] Medium along the depth: 小罗 (S7) steps half a pace forward out of 苏小满's (S1) left-rear and wedges himself into the gap between the two women, bowing his head, his voice dropped to its lowest.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.000, closer on 小罗 (S7): he speaks low in Mandarin, his eyes flicking once toward the hall doors to make sure nobody has followed them out: [Chinese] 陆总，律师那边透话。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, medium: the three of them in one depth line — 陆蔓 (S8) furthest, 苏小满 (S1) in the middle, 小罗 (S7) nearest camera and smallest of the three; the afternoon light lies flat on the blue brick.
soundscape: The steward's quick soft footfalls on the brick, his low voice close to two ears, courtyard wind in the leaves, and the distant low voices of the family at the front of the house.

title: 今天这一场，反而最像真的
summary: Still bent in close, the steward slows over the last four words — not good news, but a result he himself had not expected either.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stands nearest the camera, bent in close between the two women; 陆蔓 (S8) is furthest down the veranda with her back half turned; 苏小满 (S1) stands between them; the afternoon light lies flat on the blue brick.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): he goes on low in Mandarin, slowing over the last four words; this is not good news but a result he himself had not expected: [Chinese] 今天这一场，反而是最像真的。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.200, close on 陆蔓's (S8) face turned three-quarters toward camera: something shifts behind her eyes and is pressed down again.
[Shot 3] At 00:07.800, medium down the depth: 陆蔓 (S8) furthest, 小罗 (S7) nearest and still bent in, 苏小满 (S1) between them with her hands at her sides.
soundscape: A low steady voice close beside the two women, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, the timber balustrade settling, and the family's distant murmur at the front gate.

title: 一口气堵在胸口，拂袖走
summary: Wordless beat: the old lady's chest rises once with a breath she never lets out, then she flicks her sleeve, turns and walks on faster and heavier, her back shrinking down the veranda.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stands nearest the camera with his head still bent in; 陆蔓 (S8) is furthest down the veranda; 苏小满 (S1) stands between them; the blue brick and corridor curb hold the bottom third of frame.
[Shot 1] Medium: 陆蔓's (S8) chest rises visibly once; the breath goes in and never comes out.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.600, medium close: without another word she flicks her right sleeve, the shawl swinging out with the gesture, turns and walks on down the depth, faster and heavier than before.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.400, wide down the veranda: her back grows smaller toward the moon gate and she never turns round; 苏小满 (S1) and 小罗 (S7) stay where they are and watch her go, her shadow trailing long across the blue brick.
soundscape: 陆蔓's (S8) quickening heels on blue brick, the swing and drag of the umber shawl, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, and two held breaths behind her.

title: 一叠复印件塞给她
summary: Wordless beat: once she is gone the steward turns, pulls a thick stack of photocopies from his document bag and shoves the whole lot into the young woman's arms before anyone can see.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 陆蔓 (S8) has gone from frame down the veranda; 苏小满 (S1) and 小罗 (S7) stand in the corridor, 小罗 (S7) nearer the camera; 苏小满's hands are still empty at her sides.
[Shot 1] Close over-shoulder: 小罗 (S7) turns back to face 苏小满 (S1), draws a thick stack of photocopies from his document bag — edges square, a clip at the top — and without a word shoves the whole lot into her arms.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.200, tight on the two pairs of hands and the stack: the edge of the paper knocks against her chest and she catches it hurriedly with both hands so it will not scatter; the blue brick floor holds the bottom of frame.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.600, medium: she stands holding the thick stack against her chest, 小罗 (S7) nearest camera with his hand still hovering over it, and the veranda running far behind them.
soundscape: Paper scraping against a cotton apron, 小罗's (S7) quick breath, courtyard wind along the veranda, and the distant murmur of the family at the front of the house.

title: 待核清单，拿回去背熟了
summary: His hand still resting on the stack, the steward tells her to take the verification list home and learn it by heart.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the thick stack of the photocopied list against her chest; 小罗's (S7) hand still hovers over it; the veranda runs away behind them.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): his hand does not come back at once but rests lightly on the stack, his chin dipping toward it, and he speaks in a house-steward's Mandarin that leaves no room: [Chinese] 待核清单。拿回去背熟了。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.600, close on 苏小满's (S1) face as she listens, the stack held level at her chest; 小罗 (S7) stays nearest the camera.
soundscape: A low even voice close to her ear, the paper ticking under his palm, courtyard wind through the balustrade, and the family's distant murmur at the front gate.

title: 别再当众犯浑
summary: Frowning, he adds the last instruction and only then takes his hand back.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗's (S7) hand rests on the stack held at 苏小满's (S1) chest; the veranda runs away behind them.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): he goes on low in Mandarin and a frown crosses his brow — he truly thinks she was too hard in front of the whole room: [Chinese] 别再当众犯浑。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, medium: only now does he draw his hand back and let it hang at his side; 苏小满 (S1) still holds the stack, and the afternoon light lies flat down the blue brick.
soundscape: A low clipped voice, cloth rustling as a hand withdraws, courtyard wind in the leaves, and the low murmur of the family far off at the gate.

title: 手停在一页上
summary: Wordless beat: she balances the stack on her left forearm and flips the pages fast, then her right hand stops dead on one page and lifts the corner to look closer.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the thick stack against her chest; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest the camera with his hands at his sides; the veranda runs far behind them.
[Shot 1] Medium to close, high angle onto the paper: 苏小满 (S1) props the stack on her left forearm and flips down the pages with her right hand, fast, her eyes scanning hard.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.400, tight on the paper: her right hand stops dead; her thumb pins the corner of one page and lifts it toward her, and her brows draw together a hair.
[Shot 3] At 00:06.800, close, looking down over the page: the bottom third of frame is the page itself, the upper two-thirds are her lowered face and busy hand.
soundscape: The riffle of many thin pages turning fast, 小罗's (S7) soft footfall on the brick, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, and the low hum of the far house.

title: 小罗，你看这页
summary: Not lifting her head, she turns the page half a circle toward the steward and says it flat, pointing at one specific thing rather than complaining.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) props the stack on her left forearm with her right thumb pinning one page; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest the camera.
[Shot 1] Close over-shoulder: 苏小满 (S1) turns the page half a circle toward 小罗 (S7) without lifting her head, then lifts her eyes; at his name 小罗 (S7) bends half a step in over the paper.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, 苏小满 (S1) speaks in a level Mandarin, flat — pointing at one concrete thing rather than complaining: [Chinese] 小罗，你看这页。
[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, medium: 小罗 (S7) stoops over the page held between them with one hand braced on his own knee.
soundscape: One level voice close over paper, the paper turning against her forearm, courtyard wind along the balustrade, and the family's distant murmur behind.

title: 怎么了？
summary: The steward tips his head, brings his eyes up close to the page and asks carelessly — to him it is only a stack of archived old paper.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stoops over the page 苏小满 (S1) holds out to him, one hand braced on his knee; 苏小满 (S1) faces him with the stack on her left forearm.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): he tips his head and brings his eyes up close to the page, one hand still on his knee, and asks in a light offhand Mandarin, not yet seeing the nail inside: [Chinese] 怎么了？
[Shot 2] At 00:04.200, medium: the two of them in a near-far overlap over the sheet, her still and him stooped, with the veranda and the moon gate far behind.
soundscape: An offhand male voice close to the paper, his sleeve brushing his knee, courtyard wind in the leaves, and the low hum of the far house.

title: 病案写着，从桥南送医的
summary: Her forefinger lands on the page beside one entry and taps twice as she says, slowly, where the year's case notes have the old master sent to hospital from.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stoops over the page; 苏小满 (S1) holds it out on her left forearm, her right forefinger coming down onto the sheet.
[Shot 1] Close on 苏小满 (S1): her right forefinger falls on the page and taps twice; she speaks in a low Mandarin, a touch slower than usual, waiting for him to see the problem himself, her eyes fixed on that line and never going up to his face: [Chinese] 当年的病案写着，老爷子是从大桥南边巷口送医的。
[Shot 2] At 00:09.400, tight on the paper under her fingertip, her face and hand in the upper two-thirds of frame and the page in the lower part.
soundscape: A low deliberate voice over the paper, her fingertip tapping the sheet twice, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, and the low murmur of the family far behind.

title: 这份清单上，写的是桥北
summary: Her fingertip travels down the page to a second entry and presses on it — the case notes name one side of the river, this list names the other, the two staring at each other across the paper.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满's (S1) right forefinger rests on the page she holds out; 小罗 (S7) stoops beside her; the veranda runs away behind them.
[Shot 1] Close: her fingertip travels down from that line to another entry and stops; the camera follows her finger down the sheet.
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, 苏小满 (S1) speaks in a low Mandarin and presses her fingertip down on the second entry, like pressing at a fastening that will not fit: [Chinese] 这份清单上，写的是桥北。
[Shot 3] At 00:07.600, tight on the sheet: her face and hand in the upper two-thirds of frame and the page with its two opposed entries in the lower part.
soundscape: A low even voice over paper, her fingertip pressing the sheet, courtyard wind through the balustrade, and the family's distant murmur behind.

title: 写错了吧
summary: The steward blinks, straightens up and waves a hand as if to wave the whole thing away, smiling a don't-be-so-serious smile.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the page out with her fingertip pressed on the second entry; 小罗 (S7) stoops over it.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7): he blinks, then straightens up and waves one hand as if waving the whole thing away, smiling a don't-be-so-picky smile, and speaks in an easy Mandarin: [Chinese] 写错了吧。多少年的事了。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.800, medium: he has already glanced off toward the far end of the veranda as if about to leave; 苏小满 (S1) still holds the stack, and the veranda runs far behind them.
soundscape: An easy male voice over the paper, his palm slapping his own sleeve once, courtyard wind in the leaves, and the low hum of the far house.

title: 桥南桥北，隔一条江
summary: She lifts her eyes and looks straight at him for the first time in this exchange, and lays the case out one layer at a time, gesturing once toward the distant river.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 小罗 (S7) stands straightened, half turned as if to leave; 苏小满 (S1) holds the stack out with her finger still on the page.
[Shot 1] Close over-shoulder: 苏小满 (S1) in the near of frame lifts her eyes and looks straight at 小罗 (S7) for the first time in this exchange; unhurried she builds the sentence up layer by layer and raises one hand to point off toward the distant river: [Chinese] 桥南桥北，隔一条江。
[Shot 2] At 00:05.600, medium: her raised hand and the veranda's far depth in one frame, 小罗 (S7) nearest and still half turned away.
soundscape: A level young voice close over the paper, courtyard wind along the balustrade, the low murmur of the family far behind, and the soft creak of the timber rail.

title: 全不一样
summary: Her hand cuts one horizontal stroke across the page, then comes back and presses flat on the paper: where the rescuer came from and where she went are not the same thing at all.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the page out with one hand raised and pointing off-frame; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest the camera, half turned away.
[Shot 1] Close: 苏小满 (S1) brings her hand down and cuts one horizontal stroke across the sheet, then brings the same hand back and presses it flat on the paper; she speaks in a level Mandarin, laying out the foundation of a case in front of him: [Chinese] 救人的人从哪来，往哪走，全不一样。
[Shot 2] At 00:07.400, medium down the depth: the two of them over the page, 小罗 (S7) nearest and no longer looking away, the veranda running far behind.
soundscape: A level voice over the paper, her palm pressing flat on the sheet, courtyard wind in the pomegranate leaves, and the family's distant murmur at the gate.

title: 先把这页改过来，再谈别的
summary: Her tone actually softens as she closes the argument and presses the page flat, then looks at him and waits for an answer.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满's (S1) hand lies flat on the page; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest, watching her.
[Shot 1] Close over-shoulder: 苏小满 (S1) speaks and her tone softens half a step — she is not picking a fight but asking for this one page to be corrected first; she presses the sheet flat under her palm: [Chinese] 先把这页改过来，再谈别的。
[Shot 2] At 00:06.200, close on 小罗 (S7) as he looks back at her without answering, the afternoon light running down the veranda's blue brick between them.
soundscape: A low softening voice over the paper, her palm leaving the sheet, courtyard wind through the balustrade, and the low hum of the far house.

title: 把单子抽了回去
summary: Wordless beat: he says nothing, stares at her for several seconds, then reaches out and pulls the whole stack back from her hands in one clean movement.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满 (S1) holds the stack out with her hand flat on the page; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest, looking at her.
[Shot 1] Medium over-shoulder: 小罗 (S7) says nothing and stares at her for several seconds; then his expression shifts from offhand to appraising and his brows slowly knit, as if seeing her properly for the first time.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, close on their hands: he reaches out and pulls the whole stack back from her grip in one clean movement, the paper edges scraping across his palm; he hugs it to his own chest and steps half a pace back.
[Shot 3] At 00:08.200, tight on 苏小满's (S1) empty hands, her fingers still held in the shape they had under the paper.
soundscape: The sharp scrape of paper pulled from a grip, 小罗's (S7) slow breath, courtyard wind along the veranda, and the family's distant murmur behind.

title: 眼睛真毒
summary: Tucking the stack back into his bag, the steward mutters four words low — half unexpected admiration, half the unease of a man who has just seen trouble.
shots:
Entry state, re-anchored to the reference images: 苏小满's (S1) hands are empty and still shaped as if holding the stack; 小罗 (S7) stands nearest with the stack hugged to his chest.
[Shot 1] Close on 小罗 (S7), half turned away: he tucks the stack back into his document bag and mutters four words low, as if to himself — a little surprise in them, and a little unease: [Chinese] 眼睛真毒。
[Shot 2] At 00:04.600, medium: he walks off first down the veranda, then half turns his head for one look back at her, as if re-slotting her somewhere; the upper two-thirds of frame hold his back and profile and the lower part the blue brick.
soundscape: A low mutter almost swallowed by cloth, the document bag zipping shut, courtyard wind in the leaves, and the family's distant murmur at the front gate.
